info.title: Student Council of KPI CRM API
info.description: Session cookie authentication. State-changing requests must send the XSRF-TOKEN cookie value in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header. Errors are RFC 7807 application/problem+json with a stable `code`.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Session sign-in, sign-out and the current user

tags.name: Permissions
tags.description: Permission catalog and effective permissions of users

put.summary: Assign a role to a user (idempotent)
put.description: 404 for an unknown user or an archived/unknown role; 403 for the Admin role.

delete.summary: Revoke a role from a user (the assignment is archived; no-op when not assigned)
delete.description: 403 for the Admin role: it cannot be removed through the API.

get.summary: Get one role, including an archived one, or the built-in Admin role

put.summary: Rename a role and replace its permission set
put.description: Takes effect for all holders immediately. 403 for the Admin role.

get.summary: Get one unit, including archived ones, with its ancestor ids and active child ids

put.summary: Rename a unit / change its description

get.summary: Get one member profile, including an archived one

put.description: The faculty must be active unless it is the one already stored. 409 for an archived member.

put.summary: Edit own telegram, bio and avatar
put.description: Any signed-in member; the avatar is a file id from the files module.

get.summary: Get one faculty, including an archived one (existing profiles may reference it)
List roles (paginated, by name; the built-in Admin role first)
get.description: includeArchived=true is honoured only for holders of roles.manage.

post.description: The name is unique among active roles (409); Admin is reserved.
Allowed while assigned: holders lose its permissions. 403 for the Admin role.

Type/parent rules: LEADERSHIP has no parent and is unique; DEPARTMENT sits under LEADERSHIP or at top level; DIVISION requires a DEPARTMENT parent; WORKING_GROUP is outside the hierarchy (no parent or any active unit).

post.summary: Move a unit under another parent (null = top level)

post.description: Refused with 409 while the unit has active children or an archive guard vetoes it. Archiving a working group disbands it.

get.summary: List members (paginated, sortable by lastName, firstName, joinedAt; default lastName)
get.description: Active members only. includeArchived=true is honoured only for holders of members.archive. Directory filters are added in a later increment.

post.description: Generates a random temporary password (returned once, the account must change it on first sign-in). An initial roleId additionally requires roles.assign.

post.summary: Restore an archived member and re-enable sign-in
Reset the password to a new random temporary one
post.description: Returned once; the member must change it on next sign-in. [ASSUMPTION] governed by members.edit because CONTEXT.md 5.2 defines no dedicated permission.

post.summary: Archive a member (soft) and block sign-in
post.description: Open sessions stop working immediately. All attribution is kept. A member cannot archive themselves.
Multipart part `file`. The type is detected from the bytes and checked against the allow-list; the size is limited (default 20 MB).

get.summary: List faculties (paginated, sortable by code, nameUk, nameEn; default nameUk)
get.description: Active faculties only. includeArchived=true is honoured only for holders of settings.manage; for everyone else it is ignored.

post.description: Code and both names are unique among active faculties, case-insensitively (409 otherwise).
409 if its code or a name is now used by an active faculty.
Allowed even when profiles use it: they keep the reference, the faculty just stops being selectable.

post.summary: Sign out and invalidate the session (idempotent)
Sign in with login and password; creates an HttpOnly session cookie

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS (same answer for unknown login, wrong password, blocked or archived account)

429.description: LOGIN_LOCKED: too many failed attempts; see Retry-After

post.summary: Change the own password (required when mustChangePassword is true)

200.description: Password changed; mustChangePassword is now false

429.description: LOGIN_LOCKED: too many wrong current passwords

patch.summary: Persist the preferred UI language (uk or en)

get.summary: Roles currently assigned to a user (self, roles.assign or roles.manage)
Effective permissions of a user (self or roles.assign)
Permission catalog grouped as in CONTEXT.md 5.2, labels in the request locale

get.description: Forest of units (roots are units without a parent), siblings sorted by name. Archived units are hidden unless includeArchived=true.
Streams the bytes. PDF and images are served inline, everything else as an attachment; archived files return 404.

get.summary: The signed-in user (also answered while a password change is pending)

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED; the response still carries the XSRF-TOKEN cookie

get.description: Filters (all optional): actorId, entityId (UUIDs), entityType, action (AuditAction name), from (inclusive) and to (exclusive) as ISO-8601 instant or date (date = start of that UTC day). Invalid values yield 422 INVALID_FILTER.

get.summary: History of one object, newest first (paginated); any authenticated user
get.description: 403 for entity types registered as restricted when the permission is missing.
